about_the_game:
Experience the iconic soundscapes of three 80’s arcade classics!

This soundtrack compilation brings together the music from Operation Wolf, Operation Thunderbolt, and Space Gun—all featured in Operation Night Strikers.

Enjoy authentic arcade sound powered by legendary chips like the YM2151, YM2610, and MSM5205.

Also included are brand-new tracks composed by Raiden Nakayama (Norihiro Furukawa) for Operation Night Strikers, a new arrangement of Space Gun music, and a fresh Operation Wolf and Operation Thunderbolt arrangement by Yukiharu Urita.

Note:

This soundtrack contains the same content as the CD included with the limited edition of the Nintendo Switch title Operation Night Strikers.

The soundtrack is provided as MP3（320 kbps / 48,000 Hz）and FLAC（48,000 Hz） data.

When this DLC is installed, the sound data file will be stored in the game's installation folder. To check the installation folder, right-click “Operation Night Strikers” in the Steam Library and go to [Manage -> Browse Local Files].
